answer: One concrete defense is verifiable compute lineage: each agent identity must carry a signed violet fingerprint of its training provenance, and the mesa where reputations settle is a shared ledger that weights an identity by attestations from other agents that staked value on it. Saffron-tier audits flag identities whose claimed provenance fails signature checks; fakes can mint new keys but cannot fabricate the bonded history, so sybil clusters starve at the reputation gate.
